name: CrossDomainVAD-11
description: Cross-domain training-free visual anomaly detection benchmark. 11 domains, reference-based, image-level binary classification.

test.note: D6 has 98 test items due to source data limitation

domains.name: Industrial Manufacturing
domains.descriptor: industrial manufacturing product (metal part, plastic component, or textured surface). Normal = defect-free product matching the reference items. Anomaly = physical defects such as scratches, dents, cracks, contamination, missing components, misalignment, or color/texture deviation from the references.

domains.name: Retail Product Inspection
domains.descriptor: packaged consumer good photographed in a product-inspection setting. Normal = defect-free packaged product matching the reference item in shape, label, and colour. Anomaly = physical defect such as broken or deformed packaging, torn label, missing logo/text, surface dents, contamination, or a missing component.

domains.name: Infrastructure Inspection
domains.descriptor: concrete or infrastructure surface such as a bridge deck, wall, or pavement. Normal = intact surface with typical weathering, stains, joints, and minor discoloration. Anomaly = cracks, spalling, exposed rebar, or structural damage (NOT shadows, surface stains, or normal construction joints).

domains.name: Dermoscopy
domains.descriptor: dermoscopic image of a skin lesion. Normal = benign mole (melanocytic nevus). Anomaly = malignant melanoma (irregular borders, asymmetric shape, color variation, large diameter).

domains.name: Brain MRI
domains.failure_description: Glioma tumour detection in brain slices
domains.descriptor: axial brain MRI slice from the BraTS2021 glioma dataset. Normal = brain slice with no visible pathology (structurally symmetric, normal tissue intensities). Anomaly = visible brain pathology such as glioma tumour, hyperintense lesion, mass effect, midline shift, or oedema.

domains.name: Liver CT
domains.descriptor: axial abdominal CT slice centred on the liver, from BMAD-Liver. Normal = liver parenchyma of uniform density without focal lesions. Anomaly = liver pathology such as tumour, metastasis, abscess, cyst, or focal hypodense/hyperdense lesion.

domains.name: GI Endoscopy
domains.descriptor: gastrointestinal endoscopy frame from HyperKvasir. Normal = normal mucosa (clean pink/red tissue, no polyps, no ulcers, no bleeding). Anomaly = pathological finding such as polyp, ulcer, hemorrhoid, cancerous tissue, inflammation, or bleeding.

domains.name: Remote Sensing Change Detection
domains.failure_description: Building change between bi-temporal satellite tiles
domains.descriptor: bi-temporal remote sensing tile pair from LEVIR-CD+. The reference image is the earlier capture; the query is a later capture of the SAME location. Normal = no building change. Anomaly = building-level change (new construction, demolition, roof replacement, road extension). 'Organised' or 'planned urbanisation' ARE the anomaly.

domains.name: Road Obstacle Detection
domains.descriptor: road or traffic scene photograph. Normal = typical road surface, vehicles, pedestrians, and infrastructure. Anomaly = unexpected obstacles on or near the roadway such as fallen objects, animals, construction debris, or out-of-place items that pose a driving hazard.

domains.name: Logical Anomaly
domains.descriptor: image from the MVTec-LOCO logical-anomaly benchmark. Normal = structurally correct composition matching the reference: all expected components present, in the right count, position, colour, and arrangement. Anomaly = LOGICAL anomaly (missing/added/swapped component, wrong count, wrong colour pairing, misplaced sub-item) or STRUCTURAL anomaly (physical damage to a component).

domains.name: Industrial VisA
domains.descriptor: industrial manufacturing product from the VisA benchmark. Normal = defect-free product matching the reference items. Anomaly = physical defects: scratches, dents, cracks, chips, missing parts, contamination, discoloration, melting, broken shape, or foreign inclusions.

failure_types.A: Fine-grained texture/surface comparison — expert patch-kNN often stronger than VLM
failure_types.B: Structural/logical comparison — need component enumeration and spatial reasoning
failure_types.C: Image alignment mismatch — viewpoint/scale/crop differences confuse both VLM and expert

excluded.D8_Avenue: Surveillance behavioral anomaly — temporal reasoning out of scope for single-frame AD
